deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs
Require funded projects to track monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL
Use public reporting and increasingly on-chain KPI verification
Disburse funds after milestone completion is validated by the administrator
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds received and administered initially by an independent dRep DAO council/multisig
request.what: Cardano Builder DAO treasury withdrawal to continue and expand a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders

claims.claim: The proposal requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO funding mechanism.
The Cardano Builder DAO is described as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism intended to allocate capital to builders that advance monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Round 1 allegedly included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, an 83% governance participation rate, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 allegedly added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and reached an 88% member participation rate after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
An independent council composed of dRep DAO members will receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds prior to deployment, and oversee milestone-based disbursement.
ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to any stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds, with a transaction link provided.

summary: The document presents a 20,000,000 ADA request to scale an existing builder-led DAO funding mechanism, emphasizing KPI-linked treasury allocation, prior funding rounds, independent administration, milestone disbursement, and repayment of unused funds, but the deterministic assessment notes missing budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
